title: Bounded GLiNER2.5 joint decoder diagnostic
question: Does typed joint decoding resolve the observed independent-role inconsistency on three actual baseline windows without substituting graph coherence for source meaning?
method: Actual registered execution and bounded source-grounded inspection; software outcomes are separate from semantic quality.
conclusion: Actual GLiNER2.5 JointIE returned three feasible graphs with17 combined edges and exact entity slices.
